$comment: Hard gzip KiB ceilings for bundled, minified ESM with optional peers externalized. Reviewed byte measurements use Node 22.23.2, production esbuild, and gzip level 9. Each ceiling must satisfy the maximum headroom policy. The shared default-profile and material correctness review updates only failing entries with 2% headroom; all passing canaries retain their tighter ceilings. The theme entry includes canonical per-look contrast references and batched alias ownership after removal of redundant allocations and unused palette fields; its 13,099-byte measurement retains 2% headroom without changing other ceilings. The two component aggregate ceilings include layout-coordinate corrections for scaled scrolling and retain 2% headroom; all other ceilings remain unchanged. Categorical chart synchronization adds document-scoped coordination and renderer adapters; its 83,797-byte combined measurement retains 2% headroom, rounded up to whole bytes, without changing any other ceiling. Shared select slot readiness, viewport containment and keyboard scrolling increase the layout family by 277 gzip bytes; its 354,218-byte measurement keeps the prior 184-byte absolute allowance at a 354,402-byte ceiling. Currency-picker modules are absent from that family graph; every other ceiling is unchanged. Country, time-zone and unit selectors share one catalog form base; searchable currency and language controls add filtering and keyboard interaction. Their forms-family aggregate measures 260,872 gzip bytes, retaining the existing 2% allowance at 266,089 bytes. Catalog helpers remain granular and the complete-library, individual-control and other family ceilings are unchanged. Semantic popover trigger ownership and button toggle-state support measure 354,760 bytes in the layout family, retaining its existing 184-byte allowance at 354,944 bytes; only this failing direct-entry ceiling changes. The expanded component set and public event contracts have exact measured failing-entry ceilings rounded up to 64-byte boundaries; passing ceilings retain their prior canaries. Memoized toast focus repair adds 25 gzip bytes to the complete barrel and 23 to the overlays barrel; only these two failing ceilings advance to the next 64-byte boundary. Native form, editing, selection-veto, disclosure and lifecycle contracts have exact measured failing-entry ceilings rounded up to 64-byte boundaries. The component percentile now measures data-grid resizing and request behavior; the maximum measures agent-workspace composer passthrough. Event-only collection tree shaking removes the menu route regression. The pure root ceiling tightens to its smaller measured bundle; other passing ceilings remain unchanged. Mode-only bootstrap configuration and distinct pressed borders/outlines advance only four failing direct/aggregate ceilings to their next 64-byte boundary; the final measurements retain all other passing ceilings and dependency exclusions. The v28 document token layer (declared once per document instead of per component host), the emoji peer missing-versus-failed diagnostics, the forwarded table pager options and the shared accessible-text readings set every failing direct, aggregate and component ceiling to exactly its measured gzip bytes, with no headroom; passing ceilings are unchanged.
